policy.basis: Conservative design limits checked by scripts/check-sounds.swift, not an audio, loudness or medical norm
policy.duration_note: S1 hard limit < 3.0 s is implied by duration_s_max
policy.rise_definition: onset = first sample with |x| >= global sample peak - 40 dB; local peak = max |x| within 100 ms from onset; rise = time from onset to first sample >= local peak - 1 dB (sample metric, not a psychoacoustic rise time)
policy.rms_definition: RMS over the audible span (first to last sample with |x| > -60 dBFS); not LUFS, no true peak

sounds.source: generated by scripts/generate-sounds.swift (sine synthesis, no foreign samples)

synthesis.model: per note sum of partials amp * exp(-decay_per_s * t) * sin(2 pi hz mult t) with raised-cosine attack; notes summed; raised-cosine fade-out; peak-normalized
synthesis.output: CAF, Linear PCM 16 bit integer little-endian, mono
